name: Meridian Conflict
tagline: Build your base. Command huge armies.
description: A real-time strategy game about building bases and commanding huge armies across land, sea, air and orbit. The open playtest is live: download the launcher and play.

download.note: The playtest channel's newest install, scripts/release.sh uploads it with every playtest build.

heroVideo.note: Cut by scripts/film.sh from the game's own --film shots. It plays muted and looped over the live valley, which stays underneath as its loading state.
